chip.description: Hitachi HD63705-family microcontroller with on-die program ROM, used as the I/O and coin/input controller of Namco System 2.
chip.notes: src/mame/namco/namco65.cpp in MAME 0.288 (device full name "Namco C65 I/O") wraps an hd63705z0_device with an 8 KB internal ROM region (sys2mcpu.bin). Filed mcu under taxonomy TB2; taxonomy §4.2 already files the Namco 5xXX/6xXX satellite controllers the same way.
